scenes.headline: This candle traps buyers every day.
scenes.say: This candle traps buyers every single day.

scenes.headline: A wick above is not a breakout.
scenes.say: Price pokes above resistance, buyers jump in, and the candle closes back below the level. That's a failed breakout.

scenes.headline: Trapped buyers become sellers.
scenes.say: Everyone who bought the poke is now losing, and their stops add fuel to the drop.

scenes.title: Before you buy a breakout
scenes.say: So wait for a candle to close above the level, not just a wick.
